hooks.name: Create context on docs save
hooks.description: Runs the create-context agent when a file under docs/ is saved.

action.prompt: A file under docs/ was changed. Run the create-context agent to regenerate/update the project context based on the current documentation.

hooks.name: Create context on new docs file
hooks.description: Runs the create-context agent when a new file is added under docs/.

action.prompt: A new file was added under docs/. Run the create-context agent to regenerate/update the project context based on the current documentation.
